hypothesis: Execution validation for acyclic and affine reduction-fission capacity boundaries can use hyphenated fixture/artifact labels while exporting portable, distinct C/IR symbols. One deterministic naming rule shared by definitions, references, C declarations and dispatch rows repairs the host harness compilation failure without changing production transformations, legality, profitability or benchmark inputs.
semantics: execution_symbol replaces only hyphens with underscores, preserves existing portable spellings, and rejects non-ASCII identifier punctuation, digit/underscore starts and C11 keywords. rename_execution_functions first requires one source definition for each mapping and rejects normalized-name collisions within a mapping, with retained module globals/declarations or with any previously registered linked variant. Failed requests do not partially update the registry. A single token substitution renames definitions, exact call references and function-pointer operands together; same-prefix symbols remain distinct. All generated reference, VPlan, early scalar, boundary and narrow-fixed variants now use this helper. Existing portable symbols and hardcoded C reference declarations retain their original spelling. Boundary instrumentation is completed before simultaneous renaming, and boundary_variant uses the returned symbol/reference mapping for both C declarations and dispatch operands/counts; duplicate boundary functions reject. Artifact tags and paths keep their original hyphens. No production source, C comparison logic, probes, comparison matrix, count/result/provenance certificate or duplicate-PHI mutation is changed. Source-location remarks and stage-VF/scratch evidence are collected before host renaming and remain tied to the original target loop. The new lit regression uses actual acyclic LV1 and affine LV2 split output, checks all 26 boundary dispatch variants against their eight exact original-IR references and verifies renamed IR. Its policy/LV labels test name identity only; the full checker must freshly compile, link and execute the actual transformed paths against original IR and independent C formulas under both FP policies, repeated LV and every inherited vscale.
costs: No target transformation changes: scratch capacity, traffic, original-input rereads, contribution recomputation, producer duplication, guards, analysis passes and profitability remain unchanged. Checker additions are a small hyphen normalization/ASCII validation rule, one mapping and a linked-symbol set, existing unique-definition lookups, module token scans/substitution, and a boundary declaration/row emitter. Storage grows with the fixed validation matrix of symbols, not runtime iterations; there is no compiler analysis or target storage added. The existing fixture certificates keep their fixed-depth typed PHI/count/result and predecessor checks. The C harness and its per-variant participating-count/VF coverage bits are unchanged. Existing scratch is entry-allocated M times unique contribution sizes plus padding, capped at 65536 bytes per candidate and the signed pointer-index bound. M=65 mixed streams account for 1044 bytes (65*i32 + 65*double + 65*float + 4 padding), with 16*P logical store bytes and 16*P load bytes for compact streams (16*N each for full streams). Enclosing rows reuse 784 accounted bytes with 12*N stores and 12*N loads per row; capacity does not grow with row count. Scalar i32 capacity fixtures reserve 4/1020/65536 bytes at M=1/255/16384, transferring 8*N bytes total. Ordinal/participating counters and empty-stream guards remain. No new mask arrays, alias/SCEV versioning, dynamic scratch or extra original-input reads are introduced. Physical stack traffic, pressure, target execution and speedup are unmeasured.
limitations: The worker ran no builds, compilers, test runners, lit RUNs, VectorizeTests, execution checker or try.sh. This revision is unvalidated until the harness completes every requested check, including fresh C harness compilation/linking and complete execution, not just generating host objects. The new renamer is fixture-scoped and supports the existing unquoted LLVM names; arbitrary quoted IR symbols and general IR/C parsing are not supported. Only hyphens are normalized; other punctuation is intentionally rejected rather than silently colliding. The new naming lit labels do not establish transformed execution under either policy. Inherited result/count certificates remain limited to demonstrated bounded fixture shapes and do not prove general memory equivalence. Production limitations such as unbounded/oversized untiled storage, producer cycles/extra recurrences, unsupported calls/effects/live-outs, independent participation streams, non-affine controls and strictfp/constrained FP remain. Fixed-vscale host execution is not EVL/VP or RVV target execution; code generation is not a speedup measurement. No selection gain, performance improvement, acceptance or direction maturity is claimed. Immutable benchmarks, production legality, other worktrees, Git index/history/refs, binaries and unfinished d2 work are untouched.
test_expectations: Existing reduction-fission-compact-tail-checker.test retains the exact full affine_compact LV1 and LV2 scalar-remainder functions from t000032. Direct and one-hop outputs, renamed forwarding/output labels, renamed LCSSA values, untrusted predecessor comments and probe insertion must pass the production affine checker.

Focused mutations require the compact scalar-result diagnostic and the intended obligation. They cover wrong tail/join/output values and types, wrong starts/backedges, reversed tail/middle/bypass edges, extra branch/switch predecessors, conditional forwarding, self cycles, longer chains, additional PHIs/arithmetic/calls/stores, copy/same-prefix values, broken vector LCSSA values/types/edges/cardinality, final output linkage and ordered-FP flags. Existing count-branch tests explicitly require their existing count-provenance diagnostic instead.

The older synthetic scalar-tail fixture formerly used constants as tail results, omitted scalar/vector accumulators and discarded outputs. It now supplies real typed recurrences, distinct integer vector results, scalar resume values, an explicit zero-entry branch and final output PHIs/stores so its existing positive/probe/count mutations must satisfy the stronger certificate. No correctness rejection is removed; signature-specialization helpers/tests and exact-label construction tests are untouched.

The C harness retains all existing original/transformed/independent comparisons, aliases/canaries/signed-zero/inactive-operand checks and enclosing-row tests. It now requires entered-producer P=0, scalar-only, vector-exact and mixed paths for each compact compiled LV1/LV2, FP-option and vscale variant. It separately requires P=VF-1, VF and VF+1 where these fit the existing P=0..65 sweep. For VF>65 only zero-participant and scalar-only execution are feasible and required.

Separate duplicate matching forwarding-PHI rejection from unrelated work. All four reduction streams require compact scalar results: scalar.fission.consumer.loopexit.loopexit: forwarding PHI for the exact %u0.consume/%u1.consume/%ud.consume/%uf.consume update. Calls/stores/arithmetic and a nonmatching phi i32 [ 0, %scalar.fission.consumer.body ] still require tail forwarding work. The earlier generic forwarding PHI, conditional instruction and wrong-vector-type obligations are narrowed, never broadened.

The new symbols lit file obtains actual scalar acyclic LV1 and affine LV2 boundary output, retains every admitted M=1/255/16384 and relational capacity variant, and checks 26 distinct dispatch symbols against eight distinct exact original-IR reference definitions. Both policy names and affine LV1/LV2 labels must remain distinct. opt verification covers the emitted reference and transformed modules.

Portable names remain unchanged; hyphenated labels normalize only to underscores. Tests reject invalid lexical names/reserved external starts/C11 keywords, duplicate boundary functions, missing source definitions, normalized collisions within and across modules, repeated variants and collisions with retained definitions, declarations or globals. Failed requests retain the prior registry. Exact call and function-pointer references, same-prefix functions and simultaneous swaps are checked. Only boundary symbol spellings intentionally change, for example acyclic_one_scalar-acyclic_bounds_ordered_lv1 becomes acyclic_one_scalar_acyclic_bounds_ordered_lv1 in IR and C together. No existing test diagnostic, boundary count or correctness obligation is changed.

diagnostic_order_audit.method: Read-only inspection of immutable builds/t000033/lit.log, diffs/t000033.patch, current test/checker sources and retained actual LV1/LV2 fixtures. No test, mutation driver or checker was executed by the worker.
ordering: check_affine_function first checks unique SSA definitions and retained producer instructions.
check_compact_count checks participating-count exports, guards, rounding and bypass/termination provenance.
check_compact_scalar_results checks actual incoming edges and unconditional forwarding before reduction results.
Each typed scalar/vector recurrence, resume and result join is checked in reduction order; forwarded() requires exactly one matching PHI.
Only after all reductions pass are forwarding/middle/resume/join/result block-work counts checked.
Finally the exact output forwarding, PHIs, stores, integer combination and enclosing-row carry are checked.
